purpose: Define how housing documents are classified and mapped to legal evidence without treating document presence as proof of every legal requirement.

validation.document_identity: Identify the document before extracting facts.
validation.authenticity: Presence of a document is not independent proof of authenticity.
validation.field_consistency: Compare dates, addresses/references and descriptions across documents.
validation.legal_sufficiency: A document may support one legal element without proving the complete legal test.
validation.conflict: Conflicting extracted facts must be surfaced rather than silently resolved.

output.LEGAL_CONCLUSION: Only after the legal composition engine evaluates all required conditions.
